svg.title: A lower rate reduces resources while making fractional timing harder
svg.desc: Synthetic mathematical illustration. See the caption and adjoining model for assumptions and interpretation.
svg.text: A lower rate reduces resources while making fractional timing harder
Worst-band tone at 2 MHz; error referred to the requested fractional epoch
Same finite interpolators; changing the sample rate changes normalized bandwidth
8 taps / 16 MS/s: |complex error| ≤0.000154646 for an isolated tone across |f|≤2 MHz.
Sampled 2 MHz peak |phase error| at 16 MS/s: 0.000965° (8 taps).
A 20 ns I-path delay at 16 MS/s uses μ=0.68 and needs three future words.
Interpolation cannot establish an unknown clock offset or an unobserved LO phase.
Illustrative model • no measured receiver data
